notes:
Lead profile: early-stage devtool startup building an in-IDE AI pair programmer. Fast-moving, engineering-first team (CTO + 2 ML eng + 4 frontend). Primary ask = hosted API self-serve but with higher-than-default context window and predictable rate limits for bursts.

Key product details / requirements: 
- Primary workload: completions + multi-file context summarization + snippet search. Long context: they want to ship a feature that can surface entire file + surrounding repository context (~30k-60k tokens) by combining local context + server-side semantic index. Quote: "need ~40k token snapshots for multi-file refactors".
- Latency: interactive IDE perceived latency target ~ <=200ms token turnaround for initial experiments; accepts streaming.
- Throughput: low concurrency initially (5-20 reqs/s), but bursts when several devs run codebase-wide analysis.
- Cost sensitivity: small budgets as SMB — looking for guidance on batching, prefix caching, and quantized model suggestions to keep unit cost low.
- SDK asks: ready-to-ship JS/TS examples, Node + browser-safe auth patterns, official client snippets for streaming + resume semantics. Also asked about WebSocket/resumable streaming.
- Rate limiting: needs clear policy for bursts and dev sandbox quotas. Wants guardrails so IDE UX doesn't abruptly fail during throttle. Interested in suggested retry/backoff + queuing guidance.

Security/compliance: basic SOC2 posture preferred; must have SSO later (SAML/Okta). Audit logging required for actions (who queried which repo snapshot). Not a hard residency requirement — public cloud ok.

Commercial: SMB ARR expectations modest. They plan to start with 50 internal users, then convert to paid with 100+ users if POC successful. Estimated ARR band shared ~ $5k-$15k/year for initial pilot.

Conversation notes / quotes: 
- CTO: "we love the idea of a hosted API as long as long-window support and predictable throttles exist"
- Eng lead: "Send us sample JS streaming code and a note on worst-case token price for 40k windows"

Open actions: 
- SE to prepare SDK snippets (JS/TS Node + browser) showing streaming + resumable clients.
- Pricing: price model for long-context sessions and example bill for 1k repo-snapshots/month at 40k tokens each.
- Rate limit doc + suggested sandbox quotas for dev team.

Potential next steps: 2-week POC: 1) provide dev quota + tailored SDK, 2) small traffic test (simulated bursts), 3) collect latency/cost metrics and propose optimizations (batching/caching).
